title: Family Night of Salvations and Deliverance at The River Church
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he delivers a powerful sermon that will ignite your faith and set you free from anxiety, depression, and spiritual oppression. Through miraculous testimonies and prophetic declarations, Pastor Zehner will guide you into a deeper understanding of God's love and presence in your life, and equip you to receive the baptism in the Holy Spirit. Don't miss this life-changing message that will leave you feeling empowered, delivered, and overflowing with the Holy Spirit.
